description: NVIDIA GPU tuning and monitoring tool with voltage, clock, power and fan control, V/F curves, live telemetry and saved profiles.
notes: Tuning needs administrator rights. Profiles and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\mVolt+ and are kept on update and uninstall.
Exit mVolt+ from the tray before running 'scoop update'.
If you use Start with Windows, mVolt+ runs its own copy from %ProgramFiles%\mVolt+. Open mVolt+ as administrator once after each update to refresh it, and turn the option off before uninstalling.
